description.value: The caster emulates Leviathan’s ability to send out an echoing roar, lowering all nearby creatures’ combat prowess within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect are shaken and inflicted with a penalty to Attack rolls equal to 1d4 + the caster’s Dexterity modifier for 1d4+1 rounds unless they succeed a Will save to negate it. Learned From leviathan
